text_simplified: Tarbiyah (upbringing) of children is a tremendous responsibility. Parents must teach them din and akhlaq (moral character) from a young age. Neglecting tarbiyah leads to the corruption and loss of children, while giving it attention makes them the coolness of their parents' eyes. The prophets were keen to raise their children upon tawhid and worship.

review_defects.english: din and akhlaq (moral character) ... tawhid and worship
review_defects.why: Islamic terms are transliterated inconsistently: 'akhlaq' is glossed as 'moral character', but 'din' and 'tawhid' are left untranslated and unglossed, which may confuse readers and breaks internal consistency.
